bio: Research Overview Contact Us Bryan received his PhD in Human Genetics at the University of Michigan in 2004. He joined the lab in May 2004 and is currently studying the role of co-receptors LRP5 and LRP6 in Wnt signaling. Chen S, Bubeck D, MacDonald BT , Liang WX, Mao JH, Malinauskas T, Llorca O, Aricescu AR, Siebold C, He X, Jones EY.
